params.name: _quantity
params.description: Number of records to return (1-1000). Default 10.

params.name: _locale
params.description: Locale code controlling language/region of generated data (e.g. `en_US`, `fr_FR`, `it_IT`). Default `en_US`.

params.name: _seed
params.description: Integer seed for deterministic, reproducible output.

params.name: _categories_number
params.description: Number of fake categories to attach to each product.

params.name: _taxes
params.description: Apply a tax percentage to the generated price.

items.docs: Return a collection of fake product records with nested image references.
